Tourette’s can disinhibit speech, but it doesn’t generate ideology. At the same time, impact still matters. A racial slur is deeply offensive. That’s why live broadcasts run on delay. Tourette's Coprolalia is linked to stress, anxiety and strong emotion. Taboo words carry a strong emotional, stress and anxiety load in our brains, precisely because they are taboo words. The sufferer deliberately thinking about anything else other than the taboo word, i.e. purposefully not thinking of the taboo word, causes the stress, anxiety, and emotional load that is highly likely to involuntarily trigger the Coprolalia tick that makes them involuntarily say the taboo word. It's sort of the same effect as telling someone not to picture a pink elephant, but even more extreme.
